## Summary

- Preserve strict self-development evidence for manual releases while cleanly deferring an ineligible automatic release.
- Compile the all-feature macOS nextest archive once, extract it at the original workspace path, and fan it out to three bounded consumers.
- Discover and fail closed on every tracked Bun/npm lock; resolve all five lock audits and remove duplicate install-time advisory noise.
- Package Playwright as a VSIX runtime dependency, pin the first browser-commander release that forwards the packaged Chromium path, and exercise the real artifact.
- Isolate Gemini mutable state, trust lifecycle execution only for pinned OpenCode, and prevent archived manifests/diagnostics from being treated as live source projects.
- Preserve the complete issue, PR, CI, research, tests-first, and upstream-report record.

## Root causes and reproduction

The baseline contained a real Auto Release policy result in the wrong automatic control flow, three macOS jobs redundantly compiling before nextest partitioning, four vulnerable JavaScript surfaces hidden behind non-blocking install summaries, Gemini harness noise, and archived manifests discovered as projects.

The first pushed implementation then exposed four additional integration boundaries, all retained in the evidence archive:

- Playwright server code is not bundle-ready and followed removed private chromium-bidi paths during VSIX packaging.
- OpenCode requires its pinned package-owned postinstall to choose the Linux binary.
- nextest default archive extraction relocated binaries away from legacy compile-time Cargo paths.
- the source terminology gate scanned immutable raw CI evidence, and the requirements aggregate had not been regenerated.

Minimal red/green experiments cover each boundary. The canonical index contains the twelve named baseline logs, all initial and first-push PR logs, run/job/artifact metadata, check annotations, all three PR discussion surfaces, the reconstructed timeline, nine requirements, and the complete root-cause ledger:

[Issue 1014 evidence index](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/issue-1014-fa915643117e/dev/log/issues/1014/pulls/1015/README.md)

## Verification

- `cargo test --test unit ci_cd::issue_1014 -- --nocapture` — 12/12
- Exact registered Rust, wasm, and web CI stages — pass
- Strict all-feature clippy and all examples — pass
- Data integrity 17/17; self-AST census 10/10
- All-feature shards 488/488 and 2,777 passed with four ignored, plus every integration binary and doctests
- Desktop 140/140; VS Code 52/52; web 75/75 plus production build
- All five JavaScript lock audits — zero advisories at moderate-or-higher severity
- 720-file VSIX package and extracted-artifact Playwright browser capture — pass
- Pinned OpenCode trusted-install and nextest relocation experiments — pass
- actionlint, shellcheck, formatting, requirements assembly, diff whitespace, and committed-range policy checks — pass

The exhaustive suite completed in 1,102/1,200 seconds and retained its existing 70% performance warning instead of weakening the budget. Full output is stored under `dev/log/issues/1014/pulls/1015/local-tests/`.

Fresh GitHub workflows are running against exact head `c5fae9d4e62ed69c6b9714e27991e1bec7775ffa`; only those runs will be used for final acceptance.

## Upstream reports

- [Gemini CLI #28826](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/issues/28826)
- [web-capture #153](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/issues/153)
- [web-capture #154](https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/issues/154)
- [html-to-markdown #459](https://github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/issues/459)
- [Rust pipeline template #132](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/132)
- [JavaScript pipeline template #134](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/134)
- [Python pipeline template #58](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/58)
- Existing [Playwright #33031](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/33031) documents the bundling limitation.

Fixes #1014
